summary: OpenAI's system card accompanying the GPT-5 launch describes a unified system of fast and reasoning models routed by an internal classifier, reports improvements in benchmarks, hallucination reduction, instruction following and sycophancy, and applies High-capability biological/chemical safeguards under the Preparedness Framework.

mechanisms.reason: This is the launch system card for a new top-of-range unified model system claimed to outperform prior models and be more useful on real-world queries.
mechanisms.quote: The GPT-5 system not only outperforms previous models on benchmarks and answers questions more quickly, but -- more importantly -- is more useful for real-world queries.

practices.reason: OpenAI's own Preparedness Framework threshold classification and safeguard activation is a lab-internal safety evaluation process rather than a transferable instrument.
practices.quote: we have decided to treat gpt-5-thinking as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain under our Preparedness Framework, activating the associated safeguards.

notable_reason: This is the system card for OpenAI's GPT-5 launch, a frontier model release with a new routed multi-model architecture and a Preparedness Framework High-capability safety designation.
